GET IN TOUCH

Reach the heart of communities in Ireland

Changing Ireland is Ireland’s number-one community development magazine, publishing quality journalism since 2001.

A community-based, not-for-profit with an emphasis on positive news — with unbeatable reach.

Print distribution

15,000

PRINT READERSHIP

25+

YEARS PUBLISHING

4 X

EDITIONS PER YEAR

Print & Online reach

Loyal readership

Changing Ireland’s print edition has a loyal readership of circa 15,000. Every quarter, our magazine lands on the desks of on-the-ground staff in front-line community development organisations. It also goes to local authorities, public representatives, prison education units, and others.

Distributed to:

  • All Community Services Programme projects
  • Family Resource Centres
  • Local Development Companies
  • Universities & public libraries
  • NGOs & community sector bodies
  • TDs, Senators & local councillors
  • Irish MEPs
  • Key personnel in government departments & agencies

Advertise on our website

You can advertise directly on our website. Limited number of total adverts at any one time. Rates depend on visibility and timeline. Apply now!

Advertorials, clearly marked for readers, can be platformed on our social media (but not standard advertisements).

We have an impressive online reach across multiple platforms including Facebook, LinkedIn, Youtube, Instagram and Twitter (where we are less active since you-know-who took over). 

View Rates

Advertise in print and on our website

Choose a campaign that meets your goals — from print placements that put your message and brand in front of community sector volunteers, workers, managers and decision-makers, to digital campaigns that reach a wider audience.
